invariants.rationale: The method returns a new TableWriteStats object, so result should never be null.
The method dereferences writeMetadata, so it cannot be null on exit.
A new TableWriteStats is constructed with a non-null list, so its getStats() is non-null.
The stats list in result is produced exactly from mapping every WriteStatus in writeMetadata.
Each WriteStatus#getStat() is mapped to a stat, so unless getStat() returns null, all stats should be non-null.
